Data extraction: CSV rows are positional Sequence nodes with indexed cells

```python title="Python"
from tree_sitter_language_pack import process

def main() -> None:
    source = "a,b,c\n1,2,3\n"
    config = {"data_extraction": True, "language": "csv"}
    result = process(source, config)
    print(result.data)
    print((result.data.kind if result.data else None))
    print((result.data.children if result.data else None))

main()
```
